gen-orbitron-gf-geist-mono: Orbitron sets its letters far apart, every e showing a big open eye. Geist Mono, a monospace, sets code-style letters in fixed columns, and the big side gaps let a long paragraph move at a measured, technical pace.
gen-orbitron-gf-spline-sans-mono: Orbitron stretches wide across the line, each e showing a large, clear eye. But Spline Sans Mono, a monospace, wins on uniformity, its bold letters showing no thicker or thinner strokes anywhere.
gen-orbitron-source-serif-4: Source Serif 4 is a dignified serif, curves tightening slightly at the top. Its weight shifts are present but never dramatic, so paragraphs flow smoothly under Orbitron, whose bowls weigh the same as its stems.
gen-press-start-2p-fs-chillax: Playful and retro, Press Start 2P pins its letters far apart. Chillax, a sans-serif, draws loose spaghetti lines with pen-lifted curves, and pages of text feel relaxed and unhurried.
gen-press-start-2p-fs-plein: Plein reads reliably, with a clear channel leading into each round letter. Press Start 2P brings fun and a gentle ebb and flow of stroke weight, while Plein does its best work in its clean, moderate-height lowercase.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-alumni-sans-sc: Fun runs through Press Start 2P, whose lowercase bowls look big and open. Press Start 2P handles the novelty, while Alumni Sans SC packs squeezed lines with lowercase oversized beside its capitals.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-arsenal: Press Start 2P brings a fun, retro look, its letters pinned far apart like cut-outs. Arsenal pulls its x-height up near the cap height in a close-knit line, a quiet counterweight to all that spacing.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-arsenal-sc: Retro cut-out letters, pinned far apart: that is Press Start 2P. Arsenal SC, a sans-serif, packs its characters tight with wide-mouthed round letters, a snug line to sit beneath the heading's loose spacing.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-cal-sans: Body text here is a plain stripe of constant ink, ascenders kept short. Cal Sans runs one stroke width throughout, giving the shimmer of weight in Press Start 2P a steady surface to play against.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-carlito: Modern Carlito winds its letters tight like thread on a spool, round shapes staying clear at small sizes. But if Press Start 2P goes small, its faint thick-thin shift, already visible mainly up close, nearly vanishes.
